name: GET /ontology/:name/active — semantic-service
_fixNote: Points at a dedicated always-active ontology seeded by tests/setup_scripts/20_seed_semantic_ontology.sql (name = active_ontology_name). Previously chained off POST /ontology/register, but that same registered ontology is deprecated by POST /ontology/:id/deprecate (shared single register producer), so name-active 404'd whenever deprecate ran first. The seeded ontology is untouched by other tests -> run-order independent.

testCases.name: Fetch the active ontology by name (seeded always-active ontology)
